title: A game master's .additem puts a hat in the backpack with its name in the tooltip, the client's own trash takes it out, and it stays gone after a relog
notes: A level 5 Fire wizard with an empty backpack enters Ravenwood as a game master. The backpack B opens shows 0 of the 100 items
Inventory.Slots gives, which the server writes into the m_numItemsAllowed of the wizard's ClientWizInventoryBehavior.
'.additem 1652259' typed in chat gives the wizard Crowns-S58-Hats-L110-BS-008-01, the Balance hat the client names Cute Fairy Kei
Broadbrim. The server stores it and sends GAME MSG_INVENTORYBEHAVIOR_ADDITEM, which the client's ClientInventoryBehavior handles,
with the item unwrapped in SerializedItem; the backpack shows its row and 1 of 100, and holding the pointer on the row shows the
tooltip with its name. Choosing the row, the trash can and YES in the client's own dialog sends MSG_TRASHINVENTORYITEM with the
item's global id, and the server deletes it and sends MSG_INVENTORYBEHAVIOR_REMOVEITEM.
The client is quit and started again, and the wizard must enter with an empty backpack and no item row left.
Locking is not part of this run: the item object carries no lock yet and no handler toggles one, so a lock cannot be shown.
server_log_allowed: character_create_school holds no school, so no wizard can be created until it does
realmlist holds no realm, so no player can be sent to a gameserver until one is added

steps.name: make the main account a game master
steps.pattern: Security level of \S+ set to 2

steps.name: the client brings its renderer up
steps.pattern: About to initialize graphical client\.

steps.name: the login window is on the screen
log in
the server decodes the authentication message field by field
steps.pattern: sent MSG_USER_AUTHEN_V3: version (W\.\d+\.\d+\.\d+), revision \S+, data revision \S+, locale \S+, machine [0-9A-F]+,

steps.name: the server accepts the password
steps.pattern: authenticated as {user} \(id \d+\)

steps.name: the client is admitted
steps.pattern: The LoginServer has admitted the user

steps.name: the server lists the wizard the run made
steps.pattern: listed (\d+) character\(s\) of account \d+

steps.name: the character selection scene loads
steps.pattern: WizardCharacterSelect: The scene has been loaded successfully\.

steps.name: the character selection screen is on the screen
the wizard on the character selection screen
press play

until.pattern: sent account \d+ with wizard (\d+) to realm

steps.name: the game server spends the key
steps.pattern: Session \d+ attached: account \d+ with wizard (\d+)

steps.name: the game server sends the wizard its object
steps.pattern: put wizard \d+ in (\S+) instance \d+ at .* and sent its \d+-byte object

steps.name: the client loading the zone
the client loads the zone and the wizard stands in it
steps.pattern: loaded (\S+), and wizard \d+ stands in the world

steps.name: the wizard standing in Ravenwood
the game server answers the timed access passes
steps.pattern: Session \d+ asked for its timed access passes and was told it has none

steps.name: the game server answers the subscriber-only items
steps.pattern: Session \d+ asked which items only subscribers may use and was told none

steps.name: the game server takes the end of shopping
steps.pattern: Session \d+ is done shopping, transaction \d+

steps.name: open the empty backpack
the empty backpack holds 0 of the 100 items Inventory.Slots gives
close the empty backpack
open the chat line to type .additem
take out the slash the key writes before .additem
type .additem
send .additem
the game server gives the wizard the hat
steps.pattern: gave wizard {wizard_guid} item (\d+) of template 1652259, and its backpack holds 1 of 100 item\(s\)

steps.name: the hat is stored under the wizard
open the backpack with the hat
the hat's icon and name in the backpack, 1 of 100
the hat's tooltip names it
choose the hat
press the trash can
the client asks whether to trash the hat
answer YES

until.pattern: took item {hat_guid} of template 1652259 from wizard {wizard_guid}, and its backpack holds (\d+) item\(s\)

steps.name: the hat's row is gone
the backpack after the trash
close the backpack after the trash
quit the client and start it again
the client brings its renderer up, again
steps.pattern: About to initialize graphical client\.

steps.name: the login window is on the screen, again
log in, again
the server decodes the authentication message field by field, again
steps.pattern: sent MSG_USER_AUTHEN_V3: version (W\.\d+\.\d+\.\d+), revision \S+, data revision \S+, locale \S+, machine [0-9A-F]+,

steps.name: the server accepts the password, again
steps.pattern: authenticated as {user} \(id \d+\)

steps.name: the client is admitted, again
steps.pattern: The LoginServer has admitted the user

steps.name: the server lists the wizard the run made, again
steps.pattern: listed (\d+) character\(s\) of account \d+

steps.name: the character selection scene loads, again
steps.pattern: WizardCharacterSelect: The scene has been loaded successfully\.

steps.name: the character selection screen is on the screen, again
press play, again

until.pattern: sent account \d+ with wizard (\d+) to realm

steps.name: the wizard enters again with an empty backpack
steps.pattern: put wizard \d+ in (\S+) instance \d+ at .* and sent its \d+-byte object

steps.name: the wizard stands in the world again
steps.pattern: loaded (\S+), and wizard \d+ stands in the world

steps.name: open the backpack after relogging
the backpack after relogging holds nothing
close the backpack after relogging
the wizard still owns no item
the wizard is still connected at the next keepalive
steps.pattern: Session \d+ keepalive from the client

steps.name: the client loaded every object and item the server sent
steps.pattern: LoadObject Failed|LoadObject tried to read more data|Failed to deserialize|Failed to find core template

steps.name: the game server refused no trash
steps.pattern: refused wizard \d+'s request to trash
